newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt sees final fire blight tests soon.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt sees final fire blight tests soon.

text.p: Australian Primary Industries Minister John Anderson said on Tuesday he hoped the final fire blight test results would be available in the next few days.

"He said in relation to the fire blight issue that he hoped the final test results would be available some time in the next few days," a spokesman for the ruling Liberal-National coalition quoted Anderson as telling government parliamentarians.
Anderson said on Friday he hoped the fire blight disease was of a non-virulent strain, but tests already conducted were inconclusive.
The fire blight bacteria, which attacks pears and apples, was recently found for the first time in Australia on plants of the rose family in Adelaide and Melbourne's botanical gardens.
